capabilities: Export notes to Textile markup from the file context menu or More options menu
Convert headings, emphasis, lists, tables, images, links, blockquotes, and code blocks
Write local images as Redmine thumbnail macros (optional setting)
Copy the converted note to the clipboard
extras: Manual installation only (download main.js and manifest.json from GitHub releases); the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a Markdown note into Textile for pasting into Textile-based wikis or issue trackers.

relations.evidence: Redmine only resolves attached files, so images with a URL stay regular Textile images.

summary: Context-menu exporter that converts a Markdown note to Textile markup and copies the result to the clipboard.
